notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/rechargecard.md at 0615fbf. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 20 October 2026 on 0.1.78-c7d3348 (Biscuit's main, the 19 October build); the evidence has no later section. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Its RechargeCard.tsx is not the one the evidence describes: the file is the same on c7d3348 and c8526ae and was rewritten in ace46ca and dbe0e02 (the mirror tags' history; the package CHANGELOG has no entry for it), and the changes look like #353's fixes. Read from the installed source, rechargeCardUtils.ts, ButtonGroup and the rechargeCard tokens, not rendered. On dbe0e02: each action Button hugs its label (the card overrides ButtonGroup's equal flex: 1), so of two labels neither is cut short; with no actions (or false, '' or an empty fragment) there is no group and no extra 20 px; a string price that already starts with ₹ is not prefixed again (no ₹₹349); currency, validityLabel, dataLabel and subscriptionsLabel exist, so the ₹ and the three labels are no longer fixed; subscriptionContent false, '' or an empty fragment hides the column; disabled dims the card to half opacity, a static card too; a static card is named by accessibilityLabel or else its title. So the guide sentences these contradict are not recorded: the buttons always splitting their row into equal widths, the empty actions row adding 20 px (the Sizing sentence and the Whole card and No actions captions), the fixed labels (Content; the Plan facts anatomy note says 'fixed labels', so that part cites Sizing instead), disabled not changing the card's look, and all three Do & Don't pairs, whose reasons (View details cut short, ₹₹349, the empty row) no longer happen on dbe0e02. doDont and content.bad are therefore empty. Their advice stays where the guide gives it otherwise: give price as a number, label the main action Recharge, and give a second action Emphasis Low, as Figma does (the guide's own rule for this card; the building rules' provisional 'Two actions' rule says Emphasis Medium). Still true on dbe0e02 and recorded (read from the source and tokens): the 312 px minimum; 20 px padding top and bottom, 16 px at the sides, 20 px between rows, 20 px radius, 1 px border; title 12 px bold and disclaimer 10 px; the price at 36 px through the card's default Context3 Balance & Cards; the Avatars forced to size S; the buttons' AppearanceBrand Secondary, Button / Size S and Emphasis High defaults under the card's modes, with a Button's own modes winning; and the height gap with Figma (line heights still raised to 1.2 × the font size; not re-measured). The panel, border and text tokens alias Color Mode greys (on c7d3348 too), so 'The card's own text and panel don't change with modes' holds for every mode but Color Mode, which the app sets from the device. The guide names no other component to use instead, so the avoidWhen rule (selected or loading) has no useInstead; Biscuit's mdx (HoldingsCard, CcCard), as the evidence summarises it, is not used. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode, no style width (the guide's 312 px hosts its specimens; the card fills its host and never goes below 312 px), no Slot gap M on the In context VStack, and each action Button gets only its label and a stub onPress. Left out of examples: the guide's two-action card (it sets Emphasis Low on a Button in the actions slot) and its mode previews (Button / Size M, AppearanceBrand Primary, Emphasis Medium), which set modes on the card to restyle its buttons. Copy and plans are the guide's own: Unlimited 5G at ₹349 with the JH, JS and +2 monogram Avatars standing in for app logos (the package has no app logos), the ₹19 Data pack, and Popular plans for 98765 43210. Not recorded as gaps: the published Storybook (pressable stories, its older page, its mode controls) and the #353 items dbe0e02 fixed.

examples.purpose: Plans on the Recharge screen, one under another under a Title: the Unlimited 5G plan with the apps it includes (monogram Avatars stand in for app logos, as in the guide) and a Data pack without apps. Each Recharge starts the screen's own payment through the Button's onPress (stubs here); the card only lays out the plan.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Popular plans" subtitle="For 98765 43210" />
  <RechargeCard
    title="Unlimited 5G"
    price={349}
    validity="28 days"
    data="2 GB/day"
    disclaimer={'Unlimited voice and 100 SMS a day.\nSpeed drops to 64 kbps after 2 GB.'}
    subscriptionContent={
      <>
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="JH" />
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="JS" />
        <Avatar style="Monogram" monogram="+2" />
      </>
    }
    actions={<Button label="Recharge" onPress={() => {}} />}
  />
  <RechargeCard
    title="Data pack"
    price={19}
    validity="1 day"
    data="1.5 GB"
    disclaimer="Data only. No voice or SMS."
    actions={<Button label="Recharge" onPress={() => {}} />}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: Each Recharge starts the screen’s own payment through the Button’s onPress; the card only lays out the plan.

evidenceFacts.name: subscriptionContent
evidenceFacts.description: Wrapped in an AvatarGroup at Avatar Size S whatever the card's modes: 29 px Avatars, overlapping by 6 px.
evidenceFacts.quote: It is wrapped in `AvatarGroup` with `{ ...modes, 'Avatar Size': 'S' }` (29 px, −6 px overlap).

evidenceFacts.name: actions
evidenceFacts.description: The Buttons get AppearanceBrand Secondary (purple), Button / Size S and Emphasis High, with the card's modes on top; a Button's own modes win.
evidenceFacts.quote: with `{ AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary', 'Button / Size': 'S', Emphasis: 'High', ...modes }`; a child's own modes win.

evidenceFacts.name: onPress
evidenceFacts.description: The root becomes a Pressable with the button role, named by accessibilityLabel or else title.

evidenceFacts.name: Context3
evidenceFacts.description: The card gives its price Context3 Balance & Cards by default: 36 px, weight 900. Context3 Default on the card shrinks the price to 14 px.
evidenceFacts.quote: Price: `MoneyValue` with `Context3: 'Balance & Cards'` by default → 36 px, weight 900 (line 44). `Context3: Default` shrinks it to 14 px.

evidenceFacts.name: Avatar Size
evidenceFacts.description: Has no effect on the card's Avatars: the card forces them to S.
evidenceFacts.quote: Avatar Size from the card has no effect (forced S)

gaps.quote: Height 271 vs Figma 261 (line heights raised to 1.2 × font size).
